queries.To model chronic pain-related memory imp: Chronic constrictive injury of the sciatic nerve in male C57BL/6J mice to model neuropathic pain and chronic pain-related memory impairment, with assessment of hippocampal dentate gyrus S1P/S1PR1 signaling, spatial memory behavior, and susceptibility phenotypes.
queries.To characterize pain and memory phenotyp: Chronic constrictive injury mouse model for neuropathic pain and chronic pain-related memory impairment, assessing mechanical allodynia with von Frey filaments, thermal hyperalgesia with Hargreaves test, and spatial memory using Y-maze and Morris water maze to identify susceptible and unsusceptible phenotypes linked to hippocampal dentate gyrus S1P/S1PR1 signaling.
queries.To segregate susceptible and unsusceptib: k-means clustering to segregate mice into susceptible versus unsusceptible subpopulations using spatial memory performance cutoff values in chronic neuropathic pain models
queries.To identify molecular mechanisms underly: RNA sequencing of dentate gyrus transcriptomes from sham, susceptible, and unsusceptible chronic constrictive injury mice, differentially expressed genes and sphingolipid metabolism S1P signaling pathways
queries.To validate RNA-sequencing findings: Wes: Western blotting validation of RNA sequencing findings for S1PR1 and downstream sphingosine 1-phosphate signaling protein expression changes in hippocampal dentate gyrus of chronic neuropathic pain mice with memory impairment
queries.To test the causal role of S1PR1 in the: AAV-mediated S1PR1 knockdown and overexpression in dentate gyrus effects on chronic neuropathic pain sensitivity and spatial memory performance in mice
queries.To validate S1PR1 signaling pharmacologi: Pharmacological validation of S1PR1 signaling in the dentate gyrus using continuous cannula delivery of the S1PR1 agonist SEW2871 after chronic constrictive injury, evaluating S1PR1 expression, pain thresholds, and chronic pain-related spatial memory performance.
queries.To examine structural plasticity changes: Transmission electron microscopy and Golgi staining quantification of excitatory synapse density, postsynaptic density dimensions, dendritic complexity, total dendritic length, and spine morphology in the dentate gyrus of chronic neuropathic pain mice with memory impairment susceptibility, related to S1P/S1PR1 signaling and structural synaptic plasticity.
queries.To investigate actin cytoskeleton regula: S1PR1-mediated actin cytoskeleton regulation involving Rac1, Cdc42, Arp2/3, and ITGA2 in mouse dentate gyrus during chronic pain memory impairment, with F-actin G-actin ratios, yeast two-hybrid interaction screening, and co-immunoprecipitation validation of synaptic plasticity
queries.To validate downstream pathway and cellu: AAV-mediated ITGA2 knockdown in HT-22 hippocampal neuronal cells to assess actin cytoskeleton remodeling by phalloidin staining in S1PR1 signaling and chronic pain-related memory impairment
queries.To ensure experimental rigor and analyze: Experimental design and statistical analysis for chronic neuropathic pain memory impairment studies in mice, including controls, power analysis, blinded behavioral testing, unpaired t-tests, one-way ANOVA with post-hoc comparisons, and correlation analyses of hippocampal dentate gyrus S1P/S1PR1 signaling.
